custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an inactive part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154796-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154796-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • Active is picked.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation is titled "Activate part?": it shows part A's part number followed by its description, then "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more (no "Existing records" line and no "Stock, cost of goods" line), then the "Note (Optional)" field.
  • The Activate button is blue.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation closes and part A stays on the Inactive tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R7: “For a reactivation from the part dialog, the confirmation states "This part can be added to new work again." and nothing more.”
  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R11: “The confirm button reads "Deactivate" in red for a deactivation and "Activate" in blue for a reactivation. Cancel sits to its left.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
